abstract: PURPOSE: We evaluated the potential risk factors for disease relapse in patients with clinical stage I nonseminomatous germ cell tumors treated with surveillance and reevaluated our treatment of these patients. MATERIALS AND METHODS: A total of 211 consecutive patients with clinical stage I nonseminomatous germ cell tumors treated with surveillance after orchiectomy between 1993 and 2005 were included in this retrospective study. Risk factors evaluated were presence of vascular invasion, proportion of embryonal carcinoma, age, tumor size, preoperatively increased serum alpha-fetoprotein and the absence of yolk sac component. RESULTS: Of the 211 patients 66 (31.3%) had disease relapse. Recurrence ranged from 2 to 32 months after orchiectomy (median 6). A total of 52 (78.8%) cases of relapse were diagnosed in year 1 of followup, 11 (16.7%) during year 2 and only 3 cases were diagnosed thereafter. The first evidence of relapse was most commonly the increase in serum tumor markers alone (28.8%) or in combination with other modalities (66.7%, overall 95.5%). While 40.9% of patients with more than 50% embryonal carcinoma had disease relapse, the relapse rate was 20.8% in patients with less than 50% embryonal carcinoma (p = 0.002). Relapse rates in patients with and without vascular invasion were 75.5% and 17.9%, respectively (p = 0.000). The relapse rates were 6.1% and 75.7% in patients with no risk factors (no vascular invasion and less than 50% embryonal carcinoma) and 2 risk factors (vascular invasion and more than 50% embryonal carcinoma), respectively (p < 0.001). Multivariate analysis revealed that vascular invasion was the most powerful predictor of relapse (OR 16.350, 95% CI 5.582-47.893). Disease-free and disease specific survival rates were 97.6% at a median followup of 75 months. CONCLUSIONS: In light of our results we suggest that all patients with vascular invasion should receive chemotherapy. However, patients with no risk factors and those with more than 50% embryonal carcinoma but without vascular invasion should be on surveillance after orchiectomy since the relapse rate is less than 30%. Although strict followup in the first year is justified, followup schemas may be reassessed for the frequency of radiological investigations.
abstract_ja: 目的：精巣摘除後にサーベイランスを受けた臨床病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の患者において、再発の潜在的な危険因子を評価し、治療方針を再検討した。方法：1993年～2005年に精巣摘除後にサーベイランスを受けた臨床病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の連続211例を後方視的に検討した。評価した危険因子は、血管侵襲の有無、胎児性癌の割合、年齢、腫瘍径、術前の血清αフェトプロテイン上昇、卵黄嚢成分の欠如であった。結果：211例中66例(31.3%)に再発を認めた。再発は精巣摘除後2～32か月(中央値6か月)に生じた。再発の52例(78.8%)は1年目、11例(16.7%)は2年目に診断され、その後に診断されたのは3例のみであった。再発の初発徴候は、腫瘍マーカーの上昇のみ(28.8%)、または他の所見との併存(66.7%)が最も多かった(全体で95.5%)。胎児性癌が50%超の患者では40.9%が再発したのに対し、50%未満では20.8%であった(p=0.002)。血管侵襲の有無による再発率は75.5%と17.9%であった(p=0.000)。危険因子なし(血管侵襲なし、胎児性癌50%未満)では再発率6.1%、危険因子2つ(血管侵襲あり、胎児性癌50%超)では75.7%であった(p<0.001)。多変量解析では血管侵襲が最も強い再発予測因子であった(OR 16.350、95%CI 5.582-47.893)。中央値75か月の追跡で無病生存率および疾患特異的生存率は97.6%であった。結論：血管侵襲を有する全患者は化学療法を受けるべきである。一方、危険因子のない患者および血管侵襲はないが胎児性癌が50%超の患者は、精巣摘除後にサーベイランスとすべきである。再発率は30%未満であるためである。初年度の厳格なフォローアップは妥当であるが、画像検査の頻度については見直しの余地がある。
